page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block from top to bottom, with a woodcut of an angel-head with wings in the middle lower part, and the printer's imprint below it. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is in the background and is not transcribed. Handwritten "29" at top right and a handwritten shelf mark at bottom are not printed and are left out.

main_text.l: Theol. Professoris ordinarij, p. t. Rectoris Magnifici, fautoris & Præceptoris sui nunquam satis colendi,
Ad diem 3. Decemb. horis locoq; solitis.
Excudebat ILLUSTRISSIMÆ REIPUBLICÆ BERNENSIS TYPOGRAPHUS, Georgius Sonnleitnerus.

page.notes: The woodcut of a winged angel's head sits between the "Ad diem" line and the imprint. The "De" and "Quam" lines carry swash-style ornamental capitals. Line "HBernas" is printed as shown. The final date is printed as "M D C LXXIV" with the imprint rule above it.
